test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Q, R, S, T, U and V were six doctors sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant from each other. Q was to the immediate right of U. R was exactly in between V and T. S was to the immediate right of Q. T was second to the left of Q. Who among the following was sitting third to the right of U?
solution:
Given: Q, R, S, T, U and V were six doctors sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant from each other.

1) Q was to the immediate right of U.

2) S was to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb1f1d864f7814efbe1b328566b71b96b72e1555fceaa60e0bbf3fe6a7bf31ee.png] 

3) T was second to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb74323f6caea812ee790173eff2639d35b5d49b3592f93080f551a0b6a759e8.png] 

4) R was exactly in between V and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50840a077abb140687808e10d5f204899302ef0356c4af45c17a4a8d23a3f379.png] 

So,** V** was sitting third to the right of U.

Hence, the correct answer is** "V".**
